words: Love Oct 29 2026 2:23 PM PT: "Is there anyway you can have it save more than the last 80 hun? or at least push them to git hub?"
what: tools/exit-archive.py copies every exit from data/exit-log.json (the desk's own 80-exit window, untouched) into data/exit-log-archive.jsonl, append-only and never trimmed, and commits it to her git so it is pushed to GitHub. Runs every 10 minutes (tools/exit-archive-loop.sh); START-EXIT-ARCHIVE.command restarts it after a Mac restart. The desk and engine.ts are not touched.
